clips.title: Brussels considers allowing restrictions on Ukrainian grain in case of market 'disturbances'
clips.quote: We need to take into account the sensitivities of agricultural sectors, especially in the neighbouring countries... including on a possibility of having safeguards not only in the case of disturbances of the EU market as a whole, but also in case of disturbances of in a single member state or a few member states...
clips.speaker: Valdis Dombrovskis

clips.claim: quotas sur les importations de blé et maïs ukrainiens
clips.title: L'UE dénonce l'interdiction décidée par Varsovie et Budapest d'importer les céréales urkainiennes
clips.quote: La Commission européenne a répondu que ces interdictions unilatérales étaient inacceptables. Elle lance dans l'urgence une consultation... ce qui signifie que c'est au niveau de l'UE que de telles décisions peuvent être prises... Nous avons sur la table une nouvelle proposition pour maintenir cette suspension.
clips.speaker: Miriam García Ferrer

clips.title: Trade Commissioner wants full trade liberalization with Ukraine! AGRI Commissioner has no idea!
clips.quote: In relation to Commissioner Wojciechowski, he advocates consistently and strongly for European farmers... there's a balance to be struck here between continuing our unwavering support for Ukraine on an economic level, while at the same time listening carefully to the concerns of all relevant stakeholders... any decisions we make including in relation to the extension of the autonomous trade measures will take that evidence into account
